0022600136.text: The Magic (1-2) are playing their fourth game of the season, sitting 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, after a 1-0 road record and an 0-2 mark at home, and they come in on a one-game winning streak. The Raptors (2-1) are 5th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and they have lost their most recent game, while this is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season after Toronto beat Orlando 139-87 in their last matchup on March 29, 2026, and the Magic lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, and Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle.
